summary: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including an application for quotation of securities (ATH 1). This is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, used to notify a securities quotation request on the ASX. No terms such as price, stake, premium, or board recommendation are provided. The filing is procedural and does not represent a special situation; it is a standard listing or quotation update for existing equity. No special-situation category applies.
